dedupe_keys.name: eosda agriculture api crop weather and soil moisture data

description: A commercial API for field monitoring data from satellites and weather models. The EOSDA page says the agriculture API offers more than 15 vegetation indices, soil moisture since 2015 at 250 m resolution, and site-specific historical weather and 14-day forecasts. It is priced per request, with a free trial on request, so it is not a free download; the licence terms are not stated on the page read. Coverage is global for fields the user submits. Caveats: the page read does not give the source models behind soil moisture or weather, or accuracy figures. For simulation it gives consistent soil moisture and weather histories to estimate crop drought exposure and to drive yield models for farms and regions. A related catalogue record is the Agromonitoring Agro API.
